about: The audit rows each item of docs/verification/remaining/<key>-result.json is evidence for, read on 2026-10-16 by the coverage area (remaining-fold.cjs reads it). An item whose id is an audit row's maps to that row without an entry here. rows [] means its tests are evidence for no single row's claim, with why. `fragments`: a row-text value an area wrote as a fragment of the field, with what in the field it replaces.

banking/banking.1.why: A bank's own close (closedByBank, closeForOverdraft) has no row of its own in the audit; what a row claims that these tests reach is an order from or into an account its bank closed: it ends with the account, said once, and fails no more.

banking/banking.1.overdraft-interest.why: Close It and Cancel It settle the overdraft interest built since the 1st (settleOverdraftInterest, from 2026-10-16); the area's row text corrects both rows' changes.

banking/banking.1.standing-orders.why: An order or a payment set for a date from an account its bank closed: ends with it, or fails on its day and says so once.

banking/banking.1.pro-rata.why: The owner's decision (BGB § 675h(3)), with no test.

banking/banking.2.why: A term's interest taken before 2026-10-15 found in an older save on opening (take_term_interest's persistent, the area's row text), and given back on canceling the term.

banking/banking.s7.opening.why: The opening panel says the bank's monthly fee and waivers before Apply (the area's row text corrects its explanation); the review days and the photo ID the opening reads.

banking/banking.s7.ownership.why: The account kept at home (2026-10-16) has no row in the audit: what it claims, a bank's research on keeping a customer abroad and its closing on notice, is no row's. Reported by the coverage area.

banking/banking.s7.switching.why: No US switching service: the switch refused with the steps, and the steps each the player's.

banking/banking.s7.closure.why: Close It's refusals and what it settles; money sent to an account that isn't open comes back.

banking/banking.s7.funds.why: Money between banks in transit, in neither account, until it lands, once across a reload.

banking/banking.s7.transfers.why: Move Money pressed once moves once; fees, margin and days on a payment abroad, in whole minor units.

banking/banking.s7.rejections.why: A transfer past what the account holds refused; a payment to a closed account comes back; a payment that can't go says so once.

banking/banking.s7.statements.why: A statement's balances are the ledger's; Germany's quarters; no statement names an account after its bank closed it.

banking/banking.s7.features.why: A survey of features rows already hold (the overdraft's set-off, terms renewing); its one new test is banking.1's, folded there.

banking/banking.s7.school.why: A payment to Yale drawn on the current account and the savings at its bank (fromBankToYale); the area's row text corrects both rows' reads.

banking/banking.s7.holds.why: A survey of holds rows already hold (ChexSystems, the school's hold); its one new test is banking.s7.school's, folded there.

health-billing/health-billing.1-reprice-.why: Care repriced when a withdrawal cancels Yale Health back to the term's start (school.withdraw's changes), each bill's plan part written on its line and paid once (health.bill).

health-billing/health-billing.2-husky-d-.why: HUSKY D kept at renewal through work, the gap health.enroll is partial on, held on a FIXTURE (the area's row text corrects its issue).

health-billing/health-billing.3-insured-.why: Visits had on each cover and billed by the clock, the plan's part kept, paid once.

health-eligibility/health-eligibility.1-.why: Enroll gives the marketplace, not Covered Connecticut, to a noncitizen HUSKY D bars by status.

health-eligibility/health-eligibility.2-.why: HUSKY D's work test's exemptions at an application.

health-eligibility/health-eligibility.3-.why: The notice of noncompliance at an application and at a renewal (health.month), the area's row text correcting both rows' tests.

health-eligibility/health-eligibility.4-.why: Connecticut's look-back at a renewal, which health.month runs.

health-eligibility/health-eligibility.5-.why: The premium tax credit figured on a filed 2026 Form 1040-NR (a FIXTURE year).

health-eligibility/health-eligibility.6-.why: The work test's income of any kind, at an application and a renewal. Its row text is health.dental's alone, line numbers its edit of defects-g8-4.test.ts moved: its tests aren't dental's.

health-eligibility/health-eligibility.7-.why: The renewal's and the decision's notices, said once across a reload.

school/school.repeat-room-leave.why: repeatRoom's leave branch: Permanent Incompletes during a medical leave, and the year's repeat asked on return.

school/school.unreached-refusals.why: Its evidence names a describe of sixteen tests, each a refusal of its own command; no single row.

school/school.d-appeal-before-begun.why: A dean's leave granted from the next term: appealed, not called off (the area's row text corrects both rows).

school/school.continuity.why: Earned results kept across a leave, a return, a repeat, an additional term, the degree and reloads.

school/school.s6.missed-term.why: Missed pieces and a missed revision counted alike by the term's warning, the forecast and the faculty's review.

school/school.d-coursework-shown.why: The Evaluations panel's coursework count and Work Shown (the area's row text corrects its explanation).

school/school.s6.journey.why: Its evidence is school.continuity's, named by its describe.

school/school.s6.policy.why: SLATE's design not presented as Yale's policy: a check across the guide, the tutorial and the notices, which no single row claims.

school/school.s6.dead-ends.why: A Fail or a Permanent Incomplete that can't be repeated for names the additional term (the area's row text corrects request_repeat's explanation).

school/school.d-not-registered-hold.why: The Not Registered notice under a hold names the sum and where to pay it.

tax/tax.early_filing_notices.why: The IRS's bill at filing and its letters counted from the due date (the area's row text corrects both rows).

tax/tax.ct_filed_in_error.why: Connecticut's Filed In Error drawn only where it can act.

tax/tax.other_refusals.why: Guards across several commands, each named in its GUARD title; no single row.

tax/tax.s8.inventory.why: The papers' inventory, across the documents; no single row.

tax/tax.s8.passport.why: A passport renewed at the office's terms where the applicant is (the area's row text corrects its changes).

tax/tax.s8.idcard.why: The DMV's identity card's primary document and its Not For Federal Identification mark (the area's row text corrects its reads and changes).
